title: Cozy craft (server)
description: The official modpack used in Cozy Craft
body:
This mod pack includes all the cool bits and tricks that makes the Cozy Craft server what it is, for all those who would like to have their own version of the Cozy Craft Server. For our recommended client modpack go here: [include client link here]

This mod pack includes the following mods:
- Alternate Current(optimization)
- CC:Tweaked
- Cobblemon
- Cobblemon Secret Base Trainer
- Cobblemon Mega Showdown
- Create
- Create Deco
- Create Liquid Fuel
- Create Slice & Dice
- Create Cobblemon Manufatory
- Create Copycats+
- Create Dragons Plus
- Create Enchantment Industry
- Create New Age
- Discord Hook
- Get It Together, Drops!
- Immersive Aircraft
- Krypton Foxified(optimization)
- Open Parties And Claims
- Sophisticated Backpacks

It also contains the following necessary dependencies:
- Accessiries
- Architechtury
- Cobblemore Lib
- Kotlin for Forge
- owo
- Radical Cobblemon Trainers API
- Sophisticated Core
